entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
In Chamber
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12370 of 2020
Applicant :- Mohd Ikrar And 02 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Piyush Agrawal,J.
This bail application has been taken up during lock-down period as an urgent one.
Perused the records as well as written submission made by learned Additional Government Advocate.
The applicants are seeking bail in connection with Case Crime No. 20 of 2020, under Section 3/5/8 of Prevention of Cow Slaughter Act, P.S. Musanagar, Distt. Kanpur Nagar.

entities.text: Prevention of Cow Slaughter Act, P.S. Musanagar, Distt. Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The allegations made in the F.I.R. is that on 11.2.2020, on the information received from the informer, when the police intercepted the vehicle (J.S.A.) No. UP 77 T 0915, then it was found that the applicants were carrying beef in 03 plastic bags 100 Kg. each (total 300 Kg.) which was being transported on the said vehicle.
After being arrested, the applicants admitted that they were carrying the beef for selling in the nearby village in respect of their livelihood.

sentences.text: It has been pleaded in the affidavit filed in support of the bail application that the applicants has been falsely implicated in the present case.
One of the applicant namely Mustkeem is having Licence No. 22719427000061 issued under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 on 7.8.2019 for a period of one year in respect of running the meat shop.
The entire prosecution story is false and fabricated as there is no independent witness to prove the alleged recovery.
It is further pleaded that the applicants are in jail since 12.2.2020.

In view of overall facts and circumstance of the case and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the applicants are entitled to be admitted to bail.

Accordingly, applicants, namely, Mohd Ikrar, Mustakeem and Safik, are admitted to bail in connection with Case Crime No. 20 of 2020, under Section 3/5/8 of Prevention of Cow Slaughter Act, P.S. Musanagar, Distt. Kanpur Nagar.

entities.text: Prevention of Cow Slaughter Act, P.S. Musanagar, Distt. Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Considering the special circumstances of the lock-down prevailing in the district concerned presently and in the light of the directions of this Court in PIL No. 564 of 2020 dated 06.04.2020,
let the applicants, namely, Mohd Ikrar, Mustakeem and Safik be enlarged on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on their furnishing a personal bond only to the satisfaction of the jail authorities,
where the applicants are languishing subject to following conditions :-
(i) The applicants will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim/complainant in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicants will abide the orders of court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicants will not indulge in any unlawful activities.
(iv) The applicants will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever and shall cooperate with the police/ investigating agency.
It is further provided that this bail order available on the official website of the High Court will be taken to be the authentic one.

However, it is further directed that within period of four weeks from the date of lifting of the complete lock-down in the District concerned resulting in resumption of normal functioning of the Courts in that district, the applicants shall furnish two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned along with certified copy of this order, failing which the bail granted by this Court shall stand cancelled necessitating surrender of the applicants.

Order Date :- 21.4.2020 Rahul Dwivedi/-
